entities.summary: Mikhail Aleksandrovich Sergachev is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman and alternate captain for the Utah Mammoth of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected ninth overall by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2016 NHL entry draft. Sergachev won the Stanley Cup back-to-back with the Tampa Bay Lightning in 2020 and 2021.
